name: Ton and Vo Family Access Scholarship (Monash)
summary: $10,000 a year for a commencing Monash science, engineering or health undergraduate in financial hardship from an under-represented school.
key: $10,000 a year for up to four years.
who: Commencing undergraduate in Science, Engineering or Medicine, Nursing and Health Sciences.
ATAR of 95+, or 80+ for Indigenous Australians.
Experiencing financial hardship and attended an under-represented school.
how: Apply through the VTAC equity schemes (SEAS), or directly to Monash.

source.label: Monash: Ton and Vo Family Access Scholarship

evidence.quote: $10,000 per annum (48 credit points of study) up to a maximum of four years.
